method: Actual pinned MIDICC_CV class; only widget/registration trimmed, two namespaces closed and plugin.hpp replaced with rack.hpp. SDK InputQueue receives explicitly timestamped standard MIDI messages. Driver applies exact pinned InputDevice channel rule before queue insertion without opening a driver/device/context. Production midi_cc.rs compiled unchanged using minimal host data types. Raw frame-index comparison begins at first process call, all exposed cells/lanes each frame.

qualification_history.initial_failure: Original production Euler filter omitted the pinned SDK rounded-no-change snap; fixture and numerical gate unchanged for rerun.

tolerances.alignment: same index; no warm-up, offsets, exclusions or threshold exemptions

limitations: No application, window, native MIDI driver/device, hardware endpoint or audio device is opened

SDK channel filtering normally occurs in InputDevice::onMessage; exact source rule is reproduced in driver to avoid context/device initialization, while class process and actual SDK queue remain genuine
MIDI nonstandard signed gamepad extension excluded; ordinary 7-bit messages only
Host configuration changes use source public configuration/actual JSON mapping loader versus Rust rebuild/adoption; Learn cancellation on configuration change is explicit host policy
JSON snapshots invoke actual Rack dataToJson/dataFromJson; hardware MIDI port JSON omitted so no endpoint selection occurs

Bypass, initialization/reset/panic host policy, Engine cables/probe consumer bookkeeping, Session capture/save/Undo, transport durability/backpressure/stale identity, native GUI and performance are separate gates
This SDK/toolchain/platform combination is qualified; other platforms must execute their own reference comparison

toolchain.FMA: C++ fp contraction disabled; Rust fma target feature disabled, ordinary separate operations, no fast-math
